verification_scope: Byte identity, original ZIP CRC, original root manifests, standalone/payload comparison; no mathematical scripts executed.
nested_manifest_note: Copied upstream manifests under inputs/ are historical source documents, not manifests of the current package. Each original package root manifest is checked against its own original ZIP.
final_outer_zip_verification: Recorded separately in the external .ARCHIVE_CHECK.json bound to the final ZIP SHA-256.
